howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: From the dashboard, through Meta's embedded signup — you pick the number and approve the permissions, in minutes, with no technical setup.
howItWorks.step2Title: Your number stays on your phone
howItWorks.step2Desc: You keep receiving and replying yourself from the WhatsApp Business app whenever you want — Jawab24 works alongside you, not instead of your phone.
howItWorks.step3Desc: It replies to questions from your business info in the customer's dialect, and transcribes voice notes and answers them.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Conversations that include contact details become lead cards, with an instant push notification on your phone.

features.title: What does it do on WhatsApp?
features.f1: Understands voice notes — transcribes them and replies with a text message
features.f2: Detects 6 Arabic dialect families and replies in the customer's dialect — or in English
features.f3: Verifies every price against your info before sending — no invented prices
features.f4: Answers only from your Business Info, and holds low-confidence replies for your review
features.f5: Customizable business hours and away messages
features.f6: Reads photos customers send (a product screenshot, for example) and answers from your info

coexist.title: Your phone stays in your hands
coexist.text: Connecting Jawab24 does not take your number away: the WhatsApp Business app on your phone keeps working as it is — you receive and reply yourself whenever you want. Jawab24 answers the repetitive questions and leaves you what needs your judgment, so your customers get an instant reply without you losing control of your number.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does it work with my existing number?
faq.a1: Yes. You connect your current WhatsApp Business number through Meta's embedded signup, and the number keeps working on your phone and app as before.
faq.q2: Do I need an online store?
faq.a2: No. A WhatsApp Business number is enough — or a Facebook Page or Instagram account. Salla, Zid, and Shopify integration is optional for merchants who have a store.
faq.a3: Yes — it automatically transcribes the voice note, understands the question, and replies with a text message.
faq.a4: The Starter plan and up. Plan details are on the pricing page.
faq.q5: Which languages does it reply in?
faq.a5: The customer's own language: Arabic in its dialects (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, and MSA), English, or Franco-Arabic.
faq.a6: Yes — access is limited to what replying requires, and you can disconnect the number and delete your data at any time. See the privacy policy and the data deletion page.
